name: W. Morton Fullerton
bio: American journalist, Paris correspondent of The Times. In June 1899 Wilde, quite without money, asked him for a loan of 100 francs, to be sent to 'Monsieur Sebastian Melmoth'. Fullerton replied that he was distressed to have left the appeal unanswered so long, and addressed him by the alias without comment.
bio_note: Fullerton's documented relationships with men and his later affair with Edith Wharton are outside this volume's scope. Dates not recorded.
